Rename columns with a named vector

Source: R/import.R
rename_with_map.Rd

Rename columns with a named vector

Usage

rename_with_map(df, map)

Arguments

df

A data frame.

map

Named character vector c(OLD = "NEW"). Old names absent from df are ignored with a message.

Value

df with renamed columns.

Examples

rename_with_map(data.frame(a = 1, b = 2), c(a = "AGE", z = "ZZ"))
#> 1 name(s) not found, ignored: "z".
#>   AGE b
#> 1   1 2
